findings.note: unresolved/resolved is THREAD state, not code state. An unresolved thread may already be fixed and awaiting a reply; isOutdated only tracks whether the anchored hunk moved. Treat these as 'what the reviewer has not yet been told is closed', never as 'what is still broken'.

items.excerpt: Distinguish unsupported claims from evidence overgeneralization
Put the new harvest check in the executed workflow
Include internal consistency in the proposed check
Narrow the claimed gap in the old cross-check
Keep the checklist only in its canonical workflow

territory.note: Territory is mechanical (finding path vs. this PR's changed files). CAUSE (new-ground / propagation / wrong-fix / re-raised) is NOT derivable -- it has no machine-readable marker, and is deliberately left unclassified rather than guessed.

sinceLastReview.reason: no reviewed commit found in the snapshot (no completed reviewer pass yet)
sinceLastReview.note: Branch movement since the last reviewed commit -- NOT the PR's diff. After a merge from the base branch this includes files already reviewed and merged there. Use `artifact` for the size of what is actually under review here.

provenance.githubVia: mcp-snapshot (no bash transport reaches the GitHub API in this container)
provenance.caveat: This record contains no narration from the loop it measures. If a field is unknown it says so; nothing here is inferred from the session's own account of its rounds.
